name: Bitter...
source:
The story of a girl without memories and the young boy with her.
Days of happiness in the past.
Days of radiance are ahead.

Knowing their separation must come, today is the most important day.

Live without regret.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ073697.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
一个没有记忆的女孩和和她在一起的小男孩的故事。
幸福的日子过去了。
光辉灿烂的日子就在前方。

知道他们的分离一定会到来，今天是最重要的一天。

活得无悔。

[来自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ073697.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite英语[/url]]
